pages.title: Classification Contracts and Tree
pages.purpose: Explain the Classification, ClassificationResponse, ClassificationTree/Node models and how document classification is represented.
instructions: Describe the data model, contract/extraction_contract semantics, confidence scoring, and tree nodes.

pages.title: Completion Strategies and Handlers
pages.purpose: Explain how multi-page documents are completed when output exceeds limits: FORBIDDEN, PAGINATE (with conflict resolution), and CONCATENATE (JSON continuation) strategies.
instructions: Explain each strategy's flow, the partial-response continuation, list merging and conflict resolution in pagination, and JSON continuation in concatenation.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Document the DocumentLoader abstraction: the base contract, caching, vision mode, format support, and the various provider loaders.
instructions: Explain the loader selection mechanism in Extractor, the universal page-dict output shape, cache semantics, and representative loaders.

pages.title: Extractor and Extraction Flows
pages.purpose: Explain the Extractor: extraction and classification entrypoints, dependency validation, vision mode, message construction, completion strategies, batch processing, and error handling.
instructions: Trace load->universal->LLM flow, completion strategy dispatch, classifications, and the OpenAI batch job lifecycle.

pages.title: LLM Abstraction and Backends
pages.purpose: Explain the LLM class, its two backends (default litellm+instructor, pydantic-ai), thinking mode, router support, token/temperature configuration, and request handling.
instructions: Cover backend selection, dynamic prompting, thinking modes and page-count-based token budgeting, and where requests are issued.

pages.title: Markdown Conversion
pages.purpose: Document the MarkdownConverter: converting documents to Markdown, structured extraction with certainty scores, and vision handling.
instructions: Explain to_markdown, to_markdown_structured, page parallelism, prompts, and the basic fallback.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the top-level responsibility split of ExtractThinker: loaders, LLM, extractor, process/splitting, contracts, completions, and evals; how control and data flow through the library.
instructions: Present the modular architecture and ownership boundaries. Describe the conversion of loaded content into a universal format passed to the LLM.

pages.title: Process and Splitters
pages.purpose: Explain the Process orchestration layer, classification strategies, tree classification, and eager/lazy splitting to divide documents into groups before extraction.
instructions: Describe classify (consensus/higher-order/tree), split strategies (eager/lazy), and the doc-group extraction step.

pages.title: Adding a New Document Loader
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance guide for contributing a new DocumentLoader subclass following existing conventions.
instructions: Walk through base class contract, config dataclass, SUPPORTED_FORMATS, vision/load methods, registration in __init__, and tests.

pages.title: Changing Extraction or Completion Behavior
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance guide for modifying how an extractor builds messages, selects loaders, or handles completion strategies.
instructions: Point to the key extension seams: message construction, strategy dispatch, conflict resolution, loader selection.

pages.title: Evaluation and Quality Metrics
pages.purpose: Document the eval subsystem: Evaluator, TeacherStudentEvaluator, datasets, field comparison, hallucination detection, and cost tracking.
instructions: Explain how datasets, extractors, and metrics combine to produce reports, hallucination detection strategies, and teacher-student benchmarking.

pages.title: Testing Model
pages.purpose: Describe the test suite: critical classification tests, extraction tests across loaders/backends, and how tests are organized.
instructions: Describe the test layout and representative focused tests, noting which require external API keys or local OCR.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Get an engineer up and running with ExtractThinker: installation, a minimal extraction example, and pointers to the main systems.
instructions: Cover installing the package, loading a document loader + LLM into an Extractor, and a minimal .extract call with a Contract.
